roadmaps.title: Information Retrieval - Zero to World-Class
roadmaps.goal: Two-fold IR mastery: (a) collection side - build a smarter AI research/ingestion system that searches, reads, and archives the web into a corpus; (b) generation side - optimize the quality and speed of LLM answers over that corpus.
roadmaps.summary: For an AI engineer with strong math, probability, and ML foundations. Classical retrieval first (derived, not memorized), then corpus acquisition, then neural retrieval, ending at agentic RAG. Interleave with the Data Engineering roadmap as noted in each stage.

stages.title: Own the substrate
stages.summary: The data structures every index and ranker is built from. After this, do DE 101 (SQL) - stage 1 of the Data Engineering roadmap - before moving on.

stages.title: Build and query inverted indexes
stages.summary: Boolean retrieval, text processing as decision-making, index construction and compression essentials.

stages.title: Acquire the corpus
stages.summary: The collection side of the goal: crawling, discovery, extraction, freshness, and source credibility - retrieval judgments, not ETL mechanics.

stages.title: Rank by relevance
stages.summary: From matching to ranking: tf-idf, cosine, and efficient top-k.
courses: IR 103: Ranking I - Vector Space & tf-idf

stages.title: Measure everything
stages.summary: Ranked-retrieval metrics as an extension of the precision/recall you already own; golden query sets you will reuse in production.

stages.title: Derive BM25
stages.summary: Probabilistic ranking derived from the probability you already mastered - saturation, length normalization, smoothing. After this, do Data Engineering stages 2-4 (DE 102, DE 201, DE 202) before continuing.
courses: IR 105: Ranking II - Probabilistic Models & BM25

stages.title: Go dense
stages.summary: Embeddings, bi-encoders, ANN indexes (IVF is your k-means; HNSW is greedy graph search), and choosing/adapting embedders like an engineer.

stages.title: Compose production rankers
stages.summary: The funnel you already ship in Atrium, formalized: hybrid sparse+dense, RRF, cross-encoders, learned sparse, late interaction.

stages.title: Serve the LLM
stages.summary: Chunking, context assembly with citations, agentic and multi-hop retrieval, RAG evaluation, security, latency and cost. Finish with Data Engineering stages 5-7.

roadmaps.title: Data Engineering - The LLM Data Backbone
roadmaps.goal: Store retrieved information optimized first for high-quality LLM answers and classic ML, blending cleanly with the retrieval layer; save compute where it is cheap to; bridge to the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification.
roadmaps.summary: For an AI engineer building a research corpus. SQL from zero, modeling that unifies warehouses and corpora, storage internals, reliable pipelines, ML data correctness, the GCP stack mapped to concepts, and a capstone that assembles the whole backbone. Interleave with the Information Retrieval roadmap as noted.

stages.title: Speak SQL
stages.summary: From zero to query plans - do this right after IR 100, before the classical IR block.

stages.title: Model the data
stages.summary: Grain is chunking; SCD Type 2 is document versioning. One modeling discipline for warehouses and corpora. Start here after finishing IR 105.
courses: DE 102: Data Modeling for Analytics & Retrieval

stages.title: Master storage layout
stages.summary: Parquet internals, partitioning, compaction, and table formats - where the compute savings actually live.

stages.title: Build reliable pipelines
stages.summary: Idempotency as the center of gravity; batch and streaming semantics deep enough for the PDE exam. After this, return to IR stages 7-9.

stages.title: Feed ML and retrieval
stages.summary: Feature stores, point-in-time correctness, text pipelines, dedup mechanics, and vector stores as a product category.
courses: DE 301: Data for ML & Retrieval Pipelines

stages.title: Map it onto GCP
stages.summary: The PDE certification course: every service framed as the concept it implements, organized by exam domain.

stages.title: Assemble the backbone
stages.summary: The capstone: architecture, observability, cost engineering, the re-embedding playbook, and scenario diagnosis. Do this last, after everything else in both roadmaps.
courses: DE 401: Capstone - The LLM Data Backbone
